Transient Voltage Suppression Diodes
Surface Mount – 1500W > SMCJ series

SMCJ Series                                                                                                                            RoHS         Pb e3



 Uni-directional                                                                                Description

                                                                                                The SMCJ series is designed specifically to protect
                                                                         Bi-directional         sensitive electronic equipment from voltage transients
                                                                                                induced by lightning and other transient voltage events.
